title: PAR-20/7G.3f.4b.2 ModelDocViewStyle resource-reference closure
mode: local implementation slice with Autodesk API/DXF schema cross-check

scope.uniquenessBoundary: Exactly one target among STYLE, LTYPE, and BLOCK_RECORD collections; not a global drawing-handle census
scope.exportBehavior: Require a valid import receipt and closed resource references, then fail closed before output publication because no qualified serializer exists

sources.name: Autodesk AutoCAD DetailViewStyle properties
sources.observed: Identifier and label styles are text-style table records; arrow symbols are block table records; boundary, connection, and border references are linetype records.

sources.name: Autodesk AutoCAD SectionViewStyle properties
sources.observed: Identifier and label styles are text-style table records; start/end symbols are block table records; plane and bend references are linetype records.

testControls: Generated AC1027 ASCII and Binary DXFs parse all six DETAILVIEWSTYLE and six SECTIONVIEWSTYLE resource-edge roles against LTYPE, STYLE, and BLOCK_RECORD records.
Reject a missing target, a target found only in the wrong table-entry family, and a duplicate same-family target.
An invalid reference reaches the fileExport preflight and preserves an existing destination.
A closed valid reference graph still fails closed before output because the style serializer is unqualified.
Temporary test drawings are authored from scratch and removed; no committed fixture or CTest registration is added.

validation.command: git diff --check -- dwg2dxf/dx_data.h dwg2dxf/dx_iface.cpp tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md

remaining: Establish complete/global source-handle identity and NOD-root closure for styles and their resources.
Close BLOCK_RECORD-to-BLOCK-body requirements and handle-remap behavior for arrow symbol resources.
Implement a typed or exact-profile raw serializer for complete style payloads; otherwise retain the fail-closed output boundary.
Validate version-specific replay and native rendering separately before making conversion or consumer-support claims.
evidenceCeiling: Local generated DXF reference-role and fail-closed export controls only; not global graph closure, style serialization, DWG field-layout correctness, cross-version conversion, native rendering, or 3D support.
worktree: Uncommitted; changes are kept unstaged and unrelated existing edits are untouched.
